notes.title: Great Update v1.3.0
notes.notes:
After some time without content, we are pleased to announce the changes in Drainlive update 1.0.3, we present big changes and I hope you like it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36176693/f77d07ca4c0d75bf18a3456901f390f19d4e3593.png[/img]
[h1]Let’s start!!![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36176693/7274ad0b4b67e2074c711dc1341f83465e790813.png[/img]
[h3]Interface Remastering:[/h3]
[list]
[*] All the interfaces of the game were redesigned and re-implemented, improving notably the visual section and the usability of the same ones.
[*] The Life Bars, besides changed, now maintain a correct visibility in front of the camera, previously they rotated strangely with respect to the Camera.
[*] Changed the Logo and all the presentation resources of the game.
[*] The game remembers the last hero selection.
[*] Back the indicator showing skill ranks when hovering over them.
[*] Designed maps and enabled Mini-Maps and Maps in all Game Modes.
[*] Player and ally icons on the Map.
[*] Weapon descriptions are shown in skills when selecting a Hero.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36176693/3e1447eee64b730b56bb97bdd27deb5ccf909499.png[/img]
[h3]Beginner’s tutorial:[/h3]
[list]
[*] New tutorial, more fun, with dialogues, objectives and a new enemy.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36176693/204d6d5b580ce10b3ff2c886abaf4700755afaf8.png[/img]
[h3]Game mechanics:[/h3]
[list]
[*] To move you can now use any of the two mouse buttons.
[*] Heroes no longer turn constantly in the direction of the mouse, but by pressing a mouse button.
[*] Heroes attack automatically by pressing the Left Click on enemies that are in their range.
[*] To perform attacks without enemies nearby can be done by pressing (Shift+Click).
[*] Weapon attacks are now faster and more constant.
[*] Games start with 1 potion, the rest are obtained on the battlefield.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36176693/6f8ccab406d1b29969d47627aad5d6c3c2a3bd15.png[/img]
[h3]Game Modes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] In the game modes you now have the option to only face Bots or go against real players (Note: If there are no players connected at the moment, as a last option you will be matched with Bots).
[*] Capture the Base is now available against BOTs (Against players has always been available).
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36176693/9667a2890b5a9d1e617df51ca2d1f5d703704baa.png[/img]
[h3]Nuevo: Diario de Temporada[/h3]
[list]
[*] The “Drainlive Pass” is being replaced by the completely free Season Diary.
[*] During a season of approximately 3 months, players will have a diary full of challenges to test their skill and perseverance. Obtaining, of course, unique rewards by completing the challenges presented therein. The rewards can be used to upgrade heroes, gold, and even to obtain an ASPECT.
[*] At the end of the season the Journal, the Trophies and with it the Rank will be reset.
[*] It is possible that, with each new season, the maximum level to which the heroes can go up will increase.
[/list]

[h3]Balance:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Increase damage to Balia’s missiles from 10 to 15, in level 1.
[*] Increased the Danno of Lighting from 12 to 15 by Tik.
[*] Increased the damage of Abdon’s Mana explosion. Applies 120% of consumed mana.
[*] Battle Cry range reduced from 12 to 6.
[*] Abdon’s Meteorite marks the hit position but does 300% damage. 
[/list]

[h3]Otros:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Texture adjustments were made to improve quality.
[*] Fix: Elements visible during heroes rebirth after dying.
[*] Balance adjustments were made in some skills, due to mechanics changes and the speed of some attacks and their cooldown times.
[*] Fix: Daily quest claiming allowed to make several clicks and get the reward several times.
[*] Now the last Hero selection is remembered.
[*] Changed Doriant’s Running Animation. 
[/list]

We are still working!

notes.title: Drainlive - Update to version 1.1.0 (Abril 2021)
notes.notes:
[i]A big update for Drainlive has arrived, and this one comes with many new features, fixes, changes and improvements to the game in general. Below is the list of relevant changes included in this update.
[/i]
[h1]REWARDS FOR TROPHIES[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36176693/8ebfc29d306c7f8530d2a7bcbe2e622b848311ff.jpg[/img]

[b]Glory Path:[/b]
[list]
[*] Initially you will have 2 Champions (Ordwic and Balia), the rest will be unlocked as you progress through the Path of Glory, earning trophies to advance in the battlefields.
[*] At the beginning you will be able to play Death Matches (All vs All), the other modes will be unlocked as you advance along the path of Glory.
[*] In general you will get 60 rewards. In these you can get or unlock Heroes, new Game Modes, Gold or backpacks with various rewards.
[/list]

[h1]Friends and Teams [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36176693/4498163e306c21c4d0df365c25f5878c9f551a81.jpg[/img]

[b]FRIENDS system[/b]

Now you can have your friends in a list and see their status (online / offline / playing).

[b]Teams between FRIENDS[/b]
[list]
[*] 
[*] !NO LONGER HAVE TO GO TO THE ARENAS WITH RANDOM PLAYERS!
[*] Although it is still an option to go to battle alone, you can now invite your friends and create a custom group of up to 3 companions to go to the arena. This also applies to other team game modes.
[*] Once you invite a partner, only the Leader can invite or start the game.
[*] If you are in a 2v2 team, you can only score in Deathmatch and 2v2 Arena.
[*] Like the previous point, if you are in a team of 3 players, you can score Deathmatches and Arena 3v3. 
[/list]

[h1]UPGRADE your CHAMPIONS[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36176693/94d011aab53337228ed85aa6e4e39196d8338254.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] Champions will earn their own independent experience in each match.
[*] They all start at Level 1, and can be upgraded to Level 10.
[*] To improve a Level Champion it is necessary to obtain the necessary experience, in addition to an amount of gold according to each level.
[*] As a champion improves, they will have greater stamina and deal more damage to most of their attacks.
[/list]

[h1]NEW Game Mode[/h1]

New game modes are preparing for their launch, in this update we will have:

[b]HERO / VILLAIN. [/b]

[list]
[*] War torments many warriors, but when one of them loses his sanity, the rest of the champions will have to stop them and will become Heroes if they succeed. An enraged Champion is hard to beat.
[*] It will be a 6 player game, where 5 will be a team and 1 will be the Villain, but this enemy will be much more powerful. Therefore, a time of 2 minutes will determine in each battle if the Heroes are capable of defeating it, or it is the Villain who takes the victory.
[/list]

[h1]NEW CHAMPION - MYSTIC: [/h1]
[i]Trained by the largest cult of wizards in the mountains of Ashendore, Mystic has descended to dry land to investigate what is happening on DrainLive.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36176693/80f03608c0f99ebc7c1f78b928bf04f73c4a3b68.jpg[/img]

This Frost Mage has a high survivability. Damage is not its strength, but neither should it be neglected or ignored, as well positioned it can cause great damage.

[h1]New Daily Rewards[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36176693/2bb6860dab94ce13a9367a602d812a862008ac12.jpg[/img]

As the name suggests, you will be able to claim a daily reward to improve your progress, either GOLD, Experience for your Champions or Level Scrolls, which directly increase a level to the desired champion.

[h1]Basic Tutorial Included[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36176693/5047a136e997427c93d5c2b969e91bf4a367be3f.jpg[/img]

Once you start the game, you now have a basic tutorial on how to use the moves, attacks and special abilities of each Champion.

[h1]OTHER IMPROVEMENTS[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36176693/27aa132854ba44ffdd753cb72c650614ba706711.jpg[/img]

The game's interfaces and menus were redesigned more than 80%.

[list]
[*] Fixed multiple minor bugs.
[*] Lastly: Players with accumulated playtime will keep their trophies, gold, and accumulated experience on the heroes Ordwic, Balia, and Marcella.
[/list]

See you in discord
[url=https://discord.gg/Km9FaEsXbj]https://discord.gg/Km9FaEsXbj[/url]

notes.title: Patch notes 07/22/2020
notes.notes:
[i]Dear Drainlivers, after almost 2 months since the last update, we are pleased to release our latest patch.[/i]

[h2]Introducing Ahgia the Huntress[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36176693/99ac10ac33c3a9f4d3cf2fd290282a916c5c5029.png[/img]

“[i]Ahgia, the daughter of a Verfal and a human woman, was expelled from her village as a child, following the death of her mother. As a half-blood, her mere existence was prohibited by the nations, she was permitted to stay with her father in Verahill (The City of Emerill Forest) until she turned 15. To this day, her father remains, rotting in prison for having committed the cardinal sin of siring a human child.

As time went on, and Ahgia grew older, she became a holder of secrets, secrets that will give her redemption, and bring forth an end to the near-endless conflict between the Argos and men. She is reluctant to relay any of her secrets to the Verfal, or men for that matter. Old grudges die hard.[/i]"

[h1]Season 1[/h1]

Starting Sunday, July 26, the very first season of DrainLive begins! 
This season will last for around 3 months, ending this Halloween (October 31, 2020)
Prizes will be given to the winners of this season, who will be determined by the qualification system below.

[h2]New rankings system[/h2]

From this point onwards, qualifiers will only take place in predefined hours; we want to have a bit more of a competitive feel with this season, so we’re using a more tournament-style to achieve this.

To determine the winners, we will use two different leaderboards throughout the season.

[b]General Leaderboard[/b]: The leaderboard for a longer run. This will only reset when the season ends.

[b]Weekly Leaderboard[/b]: The more tumultuous leaderboard of the two. This resets every Saturday, so it can be a great way to tell the up-and-coming apart from the more established.

NOTE: Bots will no longer affect your ranking, although they will still affect your stats, gold, and achievements.

[h2]Events[/h2]

We will continue to hold events on Saturday nights, however we have decided to make changes to make them more competitive. Participants will have to earn their spot in the event by competing in the weekly qualifiers. The top 10 players will participate in the weekly finals, which will be uploaded to Drainlive’s social media.

You can win prizes and titles from this event, so we hope to see you compete!

[h2]Discord[/h2]

For about a month, we have primarily been using Discord as our main social platform, and are currently using it as a means of organizing the aforementioned events. Here, we directly involve the player base: we take suggestions, offer support, and discuss the finer details of the game. If you’re interested in being more active in the Drainlive community, we recommend you join the server, https://discord.gg/5wHRU9q

[h1]Changes in current champions.[/h1]

[h2]Balia[/h2]

NOW BALIA RUNS INSTEAD OF FLYING!

[i]Yes! As per your suggestions, we changed the Baila’s flying animation to a running animation, making the movement more fluid and better looking.[/i]

[list]
[*] New animations for weapon 1 and weapon 2, reflect, lightning, magic missiles and slow.
[*] Fixed reflection spell physics, now it works correctly
[*] Triple Fireball staff cooldown increased from 1 to 3 seconds and mana cost increased from 3 to 7
[*] Skull Staff's mana cost increased from 3 to 7
[*] Magic missile cooldown increased from 2 to 4 seconds and mana cost from 3 to 7
[*] Slow mana cost increased from 5 to 10 and cooldown from 2 to 4 seconds
[*] Teleport cooldown increased from 1 to 4 seconds and mana cost from 10 to 15
[/list]

[h2]Marcella[/h2]

[list]
[*] Weapon 1 damage increased from 60 to 70
[*] Weapon 2 damage increased from 50 to 60
[*] BackStep damage increased from 60 to 70
[/list]
[i]
We're looking to make Marcella more of a combo character to allow for more viability; currently, she underperforms in deathmatch events.[/i]

[h2]Ordwick[/h2]

[list]
[*] Improved Odwick Sword blocking and reversing animations
[*] Improved idle animation
[*] Improved Ordwick’s sword attack animation
[*] 
[/list]

[h2]General improvements in GamePlay[/h2]

[list]
[*] Mana was given a bit more of a purpose; champions now use it to a greater extent, and the mana potion was increased from 60 to 150.
[*] Added text of "kill 25 players to win"
[*] Fixed a glitch on the mine map, where players got stuck on spawn
[*] Corrected auto scroll chat on all maps, now also supports multiple lines (previously overlapped in the text below)
[*] When you mouse over an enemy, it lights up red and when it is an ally, it turns green
[*] Now the range of the spells is marked when you mouse over
[*] Ingame configurator added
[*] Fixed the issue that some characters were going through walls
[/list]

[h2]Improvements in the lobby[/h2]

[list]
[*] A new levelling system was implemented.
[*] Improved the scroll of the rankings, the scroll bar that was added makes it easier to navigate the list more quickly without getting stuck.
[*] Now a custom room creator can also play during the game, a button was added to convert from spectator to player and vice versa.
[*] Players in custom rooms can now change champions without leaving.
[*] Added ranks and frames in custom rooms (instead of champion)
[*] UI added to explain rank structure in game lobby
[*] Added a timer to countdown to the next event, serving also as an explanation on how the event works.
[/list]

[i]I hope you liked these improvements, remember that next Sunday the 26th will start the first week of the new season.

We hope to see you there, Drainliver![/i]

[url=https://discord.gg/5wHRU9q]https://discord.gg/5wHRU9q[/url]

notes.title: DrainLive Update
notes.notes:
Hello friends, we have prepared some updates for DrainLive

[h1]Custom rooms[/h1]

We have implemented what are custom rooms in DrainLive, these rooms will be used to create scrims or tournaments, if you are a streamer it can also be used.

The difference between custom rooms and random rooms is that they can be password protected.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36176693/adfb3ede16dda7981d09c88ff8f6ce1c147c9f0a.png[/img]

The spectator mode was also enabled, this will be the one that creates the room and will be able to observe each game to narrate the game live.

[h1]Character changes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Ordwic's "Iron Man" ability now removes stun
[*] Balia's weapons can now be silenced by the Warsong
[*] Ordwick's berserker damage increased from 70 to 90
[*] Ordwick's hammer damage increased from 50 to 70
[*] Ordwick's sword damage increased from 50 to 60
[/list]

[h1]Gameplay changes[/h1]


[list]
[*] The potions dropped by the champions were removed, it was observed that this was abused a lot and the players are almost immortal killing and taking potion repeatedly, we will test how it would be the experience without the drop of champion potions.
[*] The normal potions on the map now heal 120 (was 60) to motivate players to collect potions and make good use of them, remember that they can only collect 3 potions, for every time they use a potion it will regenerate almost all life.
[*] The gold drop was removed because the champions are now free, they are no longer purchased with gold, later that we have new rewards it will be enabled again.
[*] Kills goal changed from 15 to 25
[*] ManaDrop removed (for the same reason health was removed)
[*] The witch marcella skin now costs 6mil gold to give people a goal to collect their gold
[*] The initial gold for new accounts is now 0, before it was 3000
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Fixed the balia bug that became immune in some games.
[*] Bugs were corrected when manually leaving a room, the player left some junk data on the network, now the room cleans that data correctly.
[*] Fixed Marcella's immunity issue
[*] When Marcela became invisible she seemed to be in the same position until she appeared.
[*]Nick's space on the score list increased for long nicks
[*] A message was enabled when one player kills another
[*] The search for games was optimized, now it is entered faster
[*] Ordwick animation improved to reflect spells
[*] 
[/list]

Remember to enter our discord for support
https://discord.gg/5wHRU9q
